fields.title: Folder switching shows the correct books promptly
fields.description: The header follows selection, but old-folder cards remain during a long cancellation/scan gap. Readings records began arriving after about 93 seconds; this is eventual loading, not permanent failure.
fields.notes: Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P1. Sources F10, F13. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.
fields.deliverable: Measure loading and cancellation separately on small and large collections; prevent stale cards being presented as the new folder's books, keep the UI responsive, and preserve existing records/progress. No local import cap or subfolder picker is authorized.
